{{Quote|Has the Republic forgotten? I won the Battle of Rordak by personally boarding Moff Ceptor's battle cruiser!|Bouris Ulgo|<ref name="Usurper" />}}
The '''Battle of Rordak''' was a conflict fought at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rordak]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="Usurper" /> of [[3681 BBY|3681]]&ndash;[[3653 BBY]]<ref name="Warfare" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Sometime after [[3673 BBY]], a Republic force under the command of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bouris Ulgo]] engaged a battle group led the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ceptor (Moff)|Ceptor]]. Ceptor and the Imperial force were defeated when Ulgo himself performed a boarding action on the Moff's [[Cruiser/Legends|battle cruiser]], thereby securing victory for the Republic. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, during the [[Alderaan Civil War]], General-turned-[[King/Legends|King]] Bouris Ulgo believed that his heroism during the Battle of Rordak exempted him from Republic scrutiny in the [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] conflict on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Usurper" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Rordak's first and only appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] thus far was a brief mention in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Usurper" /> a [[LucasArts]]/[[BioWare]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2011]].<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> The conflict is mentioned by Ulgo during the Republic mission "Usurper" on Alderaan.<ref name="Usurper" />
